title: Traveler
description: Person who undertakes or wants to undertake a Trip.

undertakes.description: Trip that a Traveller undertakes or wants to undertake. Lijst van Trip items.

isFellowTravelerOf.description: Traveller who accompanies the Traveller on the Journey. For example the children of a family travelling together. Important for example when determining the price of a Ticket when young children travel free of charge. Lijst van Traveler items.
